en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a curved street lined with leafy trees and grand villas in a spa town. The printed caption reads "BAD PYRMONT Schloßstraße." and a handwritten note labels one villa as "Villa Reiling." The reverse has a handwritten German message, two Deutsches Reich Germania stamps (5 Pf and 2½ Pf) canceled in Bad Pyrmont, an address to Richard Müller, and a blue archive stamp from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
